scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test:js && npm run test:python
scripts.test:js: node --test --experimental-test-coverage tests/js/*.test.mjs && npm run test:scores && npm run test:protocol && npm run test:generator && npm run test:models
scripts.qualtrics:verify: npm run qualtrics:surveys && npm run qualtrics:test
scripts.qualtrics:build:control: node qualtrics/build.mjs --datasets chi_dynamic_v2,paired_enriched35_aided_v1,mainGame --default chi_dynamic_v2 --set TUTORIAL_ROUNDS=0 --set SHOW_INSTRUCTIONS=false --set PARTICIPANT_ID_FIELD='userID' --arm control --out bundlegame.control.js
scripts.qualtrics:build:treated: node qualtrics/build.mjs --datasets chi_dynamic_v2,paired_enriched35_aided_v1,mainGame --default chi_dynamic_v2 --set TUTORIAL_ROUNDS=0 --set SHOW_INSTRUCTIONS=false --set PARTICIPANT_ID_FIELD='userID' --with-oracle --arm counterfactual --out bundlegame.treated.js
scripts.qualtrics:surveys: npm run qualtrics:build:control && npm run qualtrics:build:treated && node qualtrics/make-survey.mjs --name "BundleGame Control" --js qualtrics/dist/bundlegame.control.js && node qualtrics/make-survey.mjs --name "BundleGame Treated" --js qualtrics/dist/bundlegame.treated.js --arms counterfactual,aggregate
